name: fixed gives every note on one velocity
about: fixed to 96 sets every note on's velocity to 96 on every channel and leaves a note off, a note on at velocity 0 and a poly touch alone.
notes: A note on (9n, v > 0) keeps its status and note and its velocity byte becomes 60, since 96 = 0x60. Everything else passes unchanged.
t 2: channel 10 (99) is a note on like any other: 99 28 60.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 3: the note off 80 24 40 keeps its release velocity 40.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 4: 90 26 00 is a release and passes as 90 26 00. Fixed to 96 it would be a note on that never ends.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 5: poly touch A0 24 50 carries a pressure, not a velocity, and passes unchanged.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: l2 asks for to 0, which would make every note on a release, and is refused bad-args.
